summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds the Update class (prologue, algebra). rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py translateUpdate always returns an Update; the empty-request path builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] before returning. rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra. rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate beside prepareQuery. rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. test/test_sparql_prepare.py adds tests for the specified behaviors. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and the DAWG and prepareQuery tests are unverified. Nothing was committed. The initBindings test uses INSERT ... WHERE {} with a variable and is the least certain test; check it first when running the suite.
